mapper.select: select p.*, m.name from tbl_expert_profile p inner join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = p.expert_seq where p.expert_seq = #{expertSeq}
select r.region_name from tbl_expert_region er inner join tbl_region r on r.region_seq = er.region_seq where er.expert_seq = #{expertSeq} order by r.region_seq

select t.*, c.name as category_name, pc.name as parent_category_name, (select count(*) from tbl_talent_portfolio tp where tp.talent_seq = t.talent_seq) as portfolio_count, (select pi.file_name from tbl_talent_portfolio tp inner join tbl_portfolio_image pi on pi.portfolio_seq = tp.portfolio_seq where tp.talent_seq = t.talent_seq and tp.slot = 1 and pi.slot = 1) as thumbnail from tbl_talent t inner join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = t.category_seq left join tbl_category pc on pc.category_seq = c.parent_seq where t.expert_seq = #{expertSeq} and t.enabled = 'Y' order by t.regdate desc

select p.*, (select count(*) from tbl_portfolio_image pi where pi.portfolio_seq = p.portfolio_seq) as image_count, (select pi.file_name from tbl_portfolio_image pi where pi.portfolio_seq = p.portfolio_seq and pi.slot = 1) as thumbnail from tbl_portfolio p where p.expert_seq = #{expertSeq} order by p.regdate desc

select p.expert_seq, m.name, count(r.review_seq) as review_count, round(avg(r.rating), 1) as average_rating from tbl_expert_profile p inner join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = p.expert_seq left join tbl_review r on r.expert_seq = p.expert_seq where p.hidden = 'N' and m.enabled = 'Y' group by p.expert_seq, m.name order by average_rating desc nulls last, review_count desc fetch first 4 rows only
